title: How small an honest test can be
statement: Size a test to the claim it must settle; how small an honest validation gate can be is still open.
example: At 50 items per type, one item moves a rate by 2 points, so a 98.8% average could not be told from a 99% target.
detail: Pass rates per item type on 50-item sets were averaged into a 98.8% projection against a 99% target; the report called the target essentially reached while noting that resolution at n=50 per cell is ±2pp and that 98.8% sits within the noise band of 99% (24 May 2026). The parallel lab's distillation left open what the smallest statistically honest validation gate is that predicts full quality without a multi-day scoring run.

evidence.quote: Statistical resolution at n=50 per cell is ±2pp; 98.8% sits within the noise band of 99%.
What is the smallest statistically honest validation gate that predicts full 26,355-row quality without a multi-day scorer run?
The C critical-recall gate alone needs roughly 299 independent critical-positive cases with zero misses for a nominal one-sided 95% bound before clustering/multiplicity.
This probe has only two rule dimensions, one prompt shell, one call per cell, no authority-removal/placebo arm, and no robust confidence bound.
